sloka: दैवासुरे च सङ्ग्रामे जनन्यै तव पार्थिव: ।सम्प्रहृष्टो ददौ राजा वरमाराधित: प्रभु: ॥ २.१०७.४॥
transliteration: daivāsure ca saṅgrāme jananyai tava pārthiva: ।samprahṛṣṭo dadau rājā varamārādhita: prabhu: ॥ 2.107.4॥

translations.english: Thereafter in the battle between gods and demons, the able king (Dasaratha) pleased (with your mother) granted her a boon (as a token of gratitude).
